reply.emotion: casual and ready, the quick, routine check of who is calling
notes: In Spain, you will often hear people use the shortened form 'el móvil' when referring to a cellular phone, as 'teléfono' is the general word for any device.
While 'teléfono' can refer to a traditional landline, it is perfectly natural to use it for any phone.

senses.definition: A device used for talking to people who are far away.

examples.text: He dejado el teléfono en la mesa del salón.
examples.translation: I left the phone on the living room table.
examples.emotion: neutral and matter-of-fact, simply noting where an item was placed
